description: Banten action reported on 17 Dec is supported only by an ANTARA search result and gives no participant count. A different ANTARA page displayed an AI crawling/indexing restriction notice; no body request was made.
required_followup: Find an accessible independent body source establishing the actual demand and whether 50 or more people gathered simultaneously.

description: Cirebon and Semarang actions are distinct local meetings with different dates/sites, while search results also point to Banten and planned Palace demonstrations. Their relationship to any national wage campaign and final active dates is unresolved.
required_followup: Check local and national follow-up reporting; do not merge on shared wage-policy context or infer campaign closure from the last article.

description: The 24/27/28 Dec Palace actions and earlier national strikes appear as announcements/cancellation stories only; actual execution is not confirmed by the captured sources.
required_followup: Search contemporaneous reporting for the stated dates; retain announcements as forecasts until an action is observed.

description: December results were concentrated on wage protests; no broad province-by-province or systematic non-labor sector sweep was completed.
required_followup: Continue region and sector searches for environmental/land, education, health, price and political-process actions.

description: The Militant search result retrospectively describes October events, but its URL date and embedded issue/date differ; publication date is kept unknown and no new December event is inferred.
required_followup: If needed, inspect through permitted access and resolve the publication-date discrepancy; this is an October continuity lead.

description: Open-web research is not equivalent to LexisNexis and cannot establish complete newspaper coverage; native query times/totals are unavailable.
required_followup: Do not claim exhaustiveness; compare with authorized archive material if available.

description: The Dec 1 Papuan student demonstration in Yogyakarta is described as a crowd filling an intersection, but no attendance estimate establishes 50 simultaneous participants.
required_followup: Seek a permissible event-specific attendance estimate from the original Tempo report or a separate contemporaneous source; keep the candidate pending if the threshold remains unproven.
